metadata.value: This repository contains the source code for running a privacy perserving federated learning simulator. The source code is currently set up for the configuration of three clients performing secure and differentially private federated learning using logistic regresion on the MNIST dataset. This library, however, is meant to be modified so as to simulate your own secure federated machine learning configuration.
